verdict.rationale: Working Copy documents a first-party Repository Agent, a conversational AI assistant that can browse files, search content, read and modify files, commit, pull and push from natural-language requests. The evidence covers only that subset of operations, the feature is opt-in, and there is no independent or hands-on confirmation. missing for 10: evidence that natural language covers the wider product surface (branching, merging, cloning, conflict resolution, configuration), and independent or hands-on corroboration of how well the agent works.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Repository Agent is an AI assistant that you interact with through conversation. Ask it to browse files, search content, read and modify files, commit, pull and push.
Code Agent & commit suggestions. Respects your data with opt-in.
